en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large, classical-style three‑storey building partly obscured by mature trees, seen from across a broad street. A low stone wall runs along the front, with pedestrians and benches visible on the sidewalk. The building has a simple but formal façade, with rows of rectangular windows and a central section bearing a crest and flagpole. In the lower left corner of the image, printed text reads "VÄNERSBORG. Residenset." and a small number "35124" appears in the lower right corner.
